tweets.text: A great milestone. What a journey!

Announcing SGLang v1.0 at SGLang Summit 🚀\
High-performance inference for LLMs and multimodal models, built for production at scale.\
\
v1.0 brings together:\
⋅Faster inference: zero-overhead scheduling, performance-critical paths rewritten in Rust, speculative decoding, and https://t.co/ddHwB5nLWm

Another mega kernel drop!\
One kernel per layer. Up to 1000 token/s on muse spark open.\
\
The finding of instruction cache is very interesting.

Megakernel blog is out now\
\
We implement a full layer (MoE + Attention) megakernel, achieving 1100 toks/s for Muse Spark, 2.1x faster than baseline.\
\
Nvidia's Instruction cache makes it really hard to write bigger kernels. We ended up tuning both instruction and data caches at https://t.co/1WaUmXRdXj

Muse Spark Open: 517 → 1,109 tokens/s on 8× GB300 with SGLang megakernels.\
One kernel launch per layer, overlapping compute, memory loads and communication. Total launches per decode step drop from 1,450 to 97.\
\
https://t.co/Bn03f8OCPJ\

DeepInfer set the bar. SGLang pushed it higher! 🚀\
\
SGLang now matches DeepInfer performance on BOTH prefill and decode:\
\
• Prefill: Up to 1.04× throughput on 4× GB300 and 4× B300\
• Decode: Up to 7.4% throughput on 64× GB300\
\
We also provide an end-to-end reproduction guide and https://t.co/KME71si9wJ
